en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a large brick institutional building on a corner, likely a hospital, with three stories and a mansard-style roof. Trees line the street in front, with a few pedestrians walking on the sidewalk. In the background to the right stands a church with a tall, narrow tower and spire. The captions in red German text at the bottom identify the location and buildings.
